text:
alex: Quick sync — final implementation pass for the pricing/packaging change is scheduled for Thursday EOD. Need a fast ownership check across metering, billing, quotas, and contracts. Who's actively blocking? @maria @kevin FYI on metering/billing readiness.

maria: I can own metering. Metering schema v2 is ready in staging but we still need one small migration script to populate historical prefix hashes. I'll run it Tuesday. No major blockers from infra. :thumbsup:

kevin: Billing adapter has a flaky retry path — saw duplicate charge attempts in sandbox when the adapter got a 504. I have a patch but need a quick review (2-line idempotency key fix). Can someone from eng-runtime glance this afternoon? @tara?

tara: I can review after stand. If kevin posts the PR link I’ll do a quick pass. Also, heads-up: contract team flagged clause C-7 about retroactive quota changes — legal wants the rollout to be opt-in for existing enterprise contracts unless sales signs off. That impacts how we roll out default quotas.

alex: Good catch on C-7. So two actionable items: (1) billing idempotency patch review, (2) decide rollout mode for customers with existing contracts. For metering, we need the migration run + a smoke test. Plan suggestion: canary 10% (non-enterprise) -> 50% -> full over 48h, with a quick rollback flag.

zach: For quotas I recommend a guarded rollout: add `quota_override: opt_in_contracts_only=true` toggle in the feature flags so we don't accidentally change enterprise customers. Small config snippet we can use in console: 
```json
{
  "feature": "pricing_packaging_v2",
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "guard": {
    "exclude_contracts_with_clause": "C-7",
    "opt_in_required": true
  }
}
```

maria: That config looks good. Also ensure metering emits `pricing_packaging_v2` metric with `migration=true` tag during the migration run so we can validate counts before and after. I'll add that to the migration script.

kevin: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/billing/merge_requests/432 — tiny change, adds `Idempotency-Key` header and honours existing keys. Tests included. @tara pinged.

tara: Reviewed, left one comment about error logging. Should be quick. After merge, we should coordinate a sandbox deploy and run the billing system test harness (link in #eng-tests).

alex: Timeline recap:
- Tue: maria runs metering migration + smoke (emit metric)
- Tue afternoon: tara reviews & kevin merges billing patch; sandbox deploy
- Wed: run end-to-end billing + metering harness; confirm no duplicates
- Thu EOD: start canary 10% (exclude C-7 contracts)
- Fri: monitor metrics, escalate if delta > 2% on billing counts

Please reply with :thumbsup: if you can hit your items or call out blockers now.

maria: :thumbsup: will run migration Tue 09:00 PT and post results here.

kevin: :thumbsup: aiming to merge by Tue 14:00 PT. If tests fail I’ll post updates.

tara: :thumbsup: I’ll review in stand then merge after fixes.

alex: Thanks — one more dependency to track: contracts needs a short template for communicating the opt-in flow to affected customers. @zach can you draft a tiny blurb that sales can copy into outreach?

zach: Yep, I’ll drop a short template in #sales-ops by EOD today.

billing-bot: Automated note: billing-harness run scheduled for 2029-11-06T18:00:00Z. Will post results to this thread when complete.

alex: Perfect. If anything changes ping me directly. I’ll convert this into a short checklist in the deployment doc after the migration result.

kevin: If anyone wants to run the billing duplicate check locally: `make billing-test && ./bin/billing-check --verify-idempotency` — small helper included in the PR.

maria: Posting migration diff and expected metric samples in a follow-up message.

alex: Thanks team — closing async check. Keep updates in this thread.
